create_TensorDict_from_tree: create a TensorDict from a nested dictionary of tensors using the from_tree class method
convert_TensorDict_to_tree: convert a TensorDict back to a nested dictionary of tensors using the to_tree method
index_TensorDict_by_tensor: index a TensorDict with tensor indices to slice all contained tensors at once
map_function_over_TensorDict: apply a function to all tensors in a TensorDict recursively using the map method
set_TensorDict_values_strict: set values in a TensorDict at tensor indices with strict key matching validation
